title: A line above the grid names the other categories the matrix prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing three new categories made for this test, category A, category B and category C.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, pricing two new categories made for this test, category D and category E.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open Settings › Categories.
  4. Click category D's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Above the grid a line reads "The", matrix A's name, "matrix also prices 2 other categories:", then category B's and category C's names with " · " between them, ending with a period (3 − 1 = 2).

Step 3:

  • Category D is listed.

Step 4:

  • The line reads "The", matrix B's name, "matrix also prices 1 other category:" and category E's name, ending with a period (2 − 1 = 1).
